paper_title: Predicting Cellular Responses to Novel Drug Perturbations at a Single-Cell Resolution

split.note: Combination holdout; CPA evaluates on unseen perturbation combinations

preprocess.note: CPA preprocessing follows scVI conventions: log1p, top HVGs. Some evaluations use fewer HVGs.

metrics.name: pearson_de
metrics.note: For cross-model comparison; CPA's native metrics focus on R2

metrics.name: r2
metrics.note: CPA's primary native metric: R2 score across all genes

reported_values._note: Approximate — CPA paper reports R2 as primary metric; pearson_de is estimated from cross-paper comparison tables. Verify against NeurIPS 2022 paper (Lotfollahi et al.).

notes: CPA uses a variational autoencoder with covariate embeddings. Important: CPA's native evaluation uses R2 not pearson_de — when comparing to GEARS/scGPT, make sure to use the same metric (pearson_de top-20). Mixing R2 and pearson_de is a common Metric Fidelity failure.
